ecution","command":"/bin/bash -lc "uv run python - <<'PY'
import asyncio
import os
import re
from pathlib import Path
import yaml
from chupa.git import Git
from chupa.seams import SubprocessExec
from chupa.specs import entry_unit_gap, resolve_plan_contract

async def main():
    root = Path.cwd()
    git = Git(SubprocessExec(), env=os.environ.copy(), timeout=30)
    print('HEAD:', await git.rev_parse(root, 'HEAD'))
    print('status:', repr(await git.status_porcelain(root)))
    plan = await git._run(root, 'show', 'HEAD:CHUPA_PLAN.md')
    match = re.search(r'"'^# BEGIN_REGISTRY_P4'"\\n(.*?)"'^# END_REGISTRY_P4$'"', plan, re.M | re.S)
    registry = yaml.safe_load(match.group(1))
    print('remaining admissions:', registry['admissions'][2:])
    for uid in ('19.P4.provider-cooldown-failover', '19.P3.thresh-runtime'):
        print('entry_unit_gap:', uid, entry_unit_gap(plan, uid))
    ids = ('19.I', '19.P4.provider-cooldown-failover', '6', '15', '19.P3.thresh-runtime', '19.L', '19.P4', '13', '19.P4.reliability-battery')
    for uid in ids:
        try:
            print('resolved:', uid, len(resolve_plan_contract(plan, [uid])))
        except Exception as exc:
            print('resolution failed:', uid, str(exc))
    print('reliability row line:', next(i for i, line in enumerate(plan.splitlines(), 1) if line.startswith('  reliability-battery:')))
    print('final status:', repr(await git.status_porcelain(root)))

asyncio.run(main())
